guide.summary: Partner integration for many customers (partner acceptance); Customer-built integration, one account (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Customer-built integration, one account (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Partner integration for many customers (partner acceptance).

composio.note: Composio manages OAuth for Greenhouse, so you can prototype without your own app. Managed apps share quota across all Composio users and show Composio's name on the consent screen.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes, since Composio supplies a managed app. For launch to outside customers under your own brand, you need partner credentials from Greenhouse, which come only after a signed partnership agreement.
reasons: Consent screen shows Composio's name, not yours, with a managed app
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum polling interval

scenarios.label: Partner integration for many customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent product connects to many different companies' Greenhouse accounts via OAuth Authorization Code flow.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "About 1-2 months (monthly review plus up to 7 business days)").

scenarios.approval: Integration request form, then Greenhouse Partnerships team review and a signed partnership agreement before Greenhouse issues credentials.

scenarios.label: Customer-built integration, one account
scenarios.when_this_applies: The integration is used only inside a single Greenhouse account, using the Client Credentials flow.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review is described for custom credentials

scenarios.approval: No provider review described; credentials are created in the customer's own Greenhouse API Credentials page.

prerequisites.title: Signed partnership agreement
prerequisites.detail: Required before you can proceed with partner OAuth setup. Start with the integration request form.

prerequisites.title: Request details ready
prerequisites.detail: Prepare the integration name, required scopes, redirect URI(s), and a 128x128 logo.

prerequisites.title: Greenhouse subscription tier
prerequisites.detail: Harvest v3 partner integrations are listed for Core, Plus and Pro tiers.

steps.title: Prototype with Composio managed OAuth
steps.detail: Use the Composio greenhouse toolkit's managed auth while waiting on Greenhouse.
steps.done_when: A test connection works through the managed app.

steps.title: Submit the integration request form
steps.detail: Fill out Greenhouse's integration request form to begin the partnership process.

steps.title: Wait for monthly review
steps.detail: Applications are reviewed on the first Monday of each month; Partnerships replies within 7 business days.

steps.title: Draft credential request details
steps.detail: Prepare the integration name, scope list and redirect URI. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Request text is ready to send.

steps.title: Sign agreement and request credentials
steps.detail: Finalize the agreement, then email partner support with testing or production choice.
steps.done_when: Greenhouse issues Client ID and Secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API using the Greenhouse client ID and secret.

steps.title: Send final redirect URI to Greenhouse
steps.detail: After the callback is tested, email Greenhouse support the final redirect_uri.

steps.title: Create Harvest V3 (OAuth) credential
steps.detail: In Greenhouse, open API Credentials, click Create new API credentials, and select Harvest V3 (OAuth). Then configure scopes.
steps.done_when: You have a Client ID and Secret.

traps.title: Partner integrations must use the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code
traps.detail: Partner integrations must use the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow.

traps.title: Authorization code lasts 1 minute
traps.detail: Exchange the code immediately. Access tokens last 1 hour, and a refresh token unused for 14 days forces users to repeat authorization.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: A redirect_uri not matching the one registered for the client ID returns an error. Greenhouse registers it, so changes need support.

traps.title: Authorizing user permissions matter
traps.detail: If the authorizing user lacks in-app permissions, calls can return 403. Some endpoints, including all list endpoints, require a Site Admin.

traps.title: Callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Greenhouse requires an exact registered redirect URI, but the Composio callback domain cannot be verified by you. Route the callback through your own domain with a redirect proxy that 302-redirects to Composio.

traps.title: Scopes must be permitted for your client
traps.detail: Requesting scopes your client is not permitted produces invalid_scope or a 401 on token exchange.

blockers.symptom: Cannot get Client ID and Secret

blockers.what_to_do: Submit the integration request form and wait for the monthly review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the form answers and credential request email.

blockers.what_it_means: Out-of-cycle review is generally granted only for an urgent request from a mutual customer.
blockers.what_to_do: Email partneronboarding@greenhouse.io with the customer's urgent request.

open_questions: How long does the agreement and credential issuance take after review? Ask partner-support@greenhouse.io.
What does Greenhouse check in the partner review, and what are its approval criteria? Not documented; ask Partnerships.
Is there a fee or minimum customer count for partners? Not stated; ask Partnerships.
Which scopes would an AI agent need, and do any trigger extra review? See the Harvest API reference or ask Partnerships.
